contract_not_found.message: The Iléo account no longer holds contract {contract}.

contract_not_found.title: Contract {contract} is no longer on this Iléo account
contract_not_found.description:
The stored Iléo account no longer holds contract {contract}: its readings are not fetched any more.

Attach the contract to this account on mel-ileo.fr, or open the menu of the Iléo integration and choose **Reconfigure** to give the account that holds it.

This alert goes away at the next successful fetch.
